FX-SELC-001.says: The settings as they start: relative, every amount 0: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-SELC-002.says: Reds, cyan +100, absolute: the reds lose their red by as much as they are red, pure red goes black, orange olive, skin greyer; colours with no red family (greys, green, cyan, blue) are untouched.

FX-SELC-003.says: The same, relative: a channel's change is scaled by how much room it has below full, so pure red and orange, whose red is full, are untouched and the darker rows change most.

FX-SELC-004.says: Yellows, yellow -100, absolute: the yellows' blue raised by as much as they are yellow: pure yellow becomes white, orange pink, the warm tones greyer.

FX-SELC-005.says: Greens, magenta +100, absolute: the greens' green taken down, pure green to black; yellow and cyan, where green ties for largest, untouched.

FX-SELC-006.says: Cyans, cyan -100, relative: the cyans' red raised, pure cyan becomes white.

FX-SELC-007.says: Blues, yellow +100, absolute: the blues' blue taken down, pure blue to black; cyan and magenta, where blue ties for largest, untouched.

FX-SELC-008.says: Magentas, magenta -50 and black +50, absolute: the black darkens red and blue by half; on green the black and the magenta cut partly cancel, so pure magenta's green rises a quarter.

FX-SELC-009.says: Whites, black +100, absolute: the light pixels darkened by how light they are, white to black, the light greys and the skin and warm highlight darker; nothing at or below half grey changes.

FX-SELC-010.says: The same, relative: a full channel can't be changed, so pure white stays white (Adobe's note); the light greys still darken.

FX-SELC-011.says: Neutrals, cyan -30, yellow +40, relative: the midtones warmed, more red and less blue, most at half grey; pure colours, black and white untouched.

FX-SELC-012.says: Blacks, black -50, relative: the dark pixels lifted by how dark they are, black to half grey's level; nothing at or above half grey changes.

FX-SELC-013.says: Reds, cyan 40, magenta -60, yellow 10, black 20, absolute, Bœsch's Photoshop settings: the black darkening every channel as the colour changes shift them.

FX-SELC-014.says: Reds, every amount +100, absolute: each change held at the channel's own floor, the reds go to black by as much as they are red.

FX-SELC-015.says: All nine families at once, relative: each pixel moved by every family it belongs to, added together.

FX-SELC-016.says: All nine, absolute: the same amounts, unscaled, so larger changes.

FX-SELC-017.says: Reds keyed from 0, 0, 0, 0 at frame 0 to cyan +100 at frame 4, linear, absolute: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 cyan +50, frame 4 as FX-SELC-002.

FX-SELC-018.says: FX-SELC-015 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SELC-019.says: Reds' cyan 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELC-020.says: Blacks' black -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELC-021.says: Greens three numbers, not four. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELC-022.says: Method "Relative": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELC-023.says: Method "percentage", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
